args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (from #inc-qfl-sev1, 4 Nov 2025)
• Impact: Dock schedule sync at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Superior terminal stopped, starting around 6:40 AM terminal time. Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM; drivers were backing up at the guard shack and tablets were spinning.
• Cause found by: Samir Patel (on-call), at 7:17 AM – a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Recovery: Stuck jobs cleared and a partial sync reached Superior around 8:15 AM, with a few inbound trailers still duplicating. Samir deployed the hotfix and finished the replay script at 2:38 PM, after which all Superior dock schedules synced cleanly in real time.
• Resolved: Declared resolved at 2:44 PM, after Thea confirmed from the yard.
Notes: times are as logged in the incident channel (the log doesn't state a time zone). A postmortem hasn't been posted there, so I've left out any root-cause detail beyond the webhook listener. Dana, please check and edit before it goes to Thea.

Dana, I've posted the draft recap in #north-team. I built it from #inc-qfl-sev1, where you're a member.

- **Broke:** The Superior dock sync stopped at about 6:40 AM terminal time on 4 Nov 2025. You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause found by:** Samir Patel, at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir's hotfix and replay script finished at 2:38 PM, and Superior then synced cleanly in real time. You declared it resolved at 2:44 PM, after Thea confirmed. A partial sync had come back around 8:15 AM, but some trailers were still duplicating.

- **Time zone:** The channel log doesn't give one, so the draft uses the times as logged.
- **Postmortem:** None is posted yet, so the draft says nothing about root cause beyond the webhook listener.

Please check and edit it before it goes to Thea.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
